source.name: San Jose Earthquakes – 'NEWS: San Jose Earthquakes and El Camino Health Announce Landmark Community-Focused Partnership'
source.quote: On the field, El Camino Health’s brand will adorn the front of the Earthquakes first-team jerseys, beginning with the upcoming 2025 Major League Soccer season
source.note: Multi-year front deal announced 2025-01-29; FOR SOCCER's 2026 MLS jersey sponsor list (2026-02-17) still lists El Camino Health on the Earthquakes front for 2026.

source.name: San Jose Earthquakes – 'San Jose Earthquakes and Apollo Announce Official Sleeve and Go-to-Market Partnership, Bringing the AI GTM System to Major League Soccer'
source.quote: Apollo will serve as both a brand sponsor with its logo featured prominently on the right sleeve of the Earthquakes’ jersey
source.note: Multiyear deal debuting at the California Clásico on 2026-07-25; the right sleeve was unsponsored at the start of the 2026 season (FOR SOCCER, 2026-02-17).

source.name: San Jose Earthquakes – 'San Jose Earthquakes and DUDE Wipes Announce Official Back-of-Jersey Partnership'
source.quote: Starting with the Earthquakes’ Aug. 1 match against FC Cincinnati, the DUDE Wipes logo will appear on the back of the Major League Soccer club’s first-team jerseys
source.note: Multiyear back-of-jersey deal under a new league asset allowed only from 1 August 2026 (after the 2026 All-Star break); no back sponsor before that date.

source.name: FOR SOCCER – '2026 MLS Jersey Sponsors'
source.quote: media partner Apple, once again, will be on the left sleeve of every jersey
source.note: League-wide left-sleeve patch on all 30 MLS kits under the Apple–MLS broadcast deal (see deal mls-apple-tv).

summary: adidas home kit. El Camino Health fronts the shirt from 2025; Apollo has the right sleeve since late July 2026; DUDE Wipes appears on the back from 1 August 2026 under the league's new back-ads rule; the league-wide Apple TV patch is on the left sleeve. No sponsor image on file.
